hafas.purpose: German transit data via community HAFAS REST wrappers (DB, VBB, BVG instances)
hafas.dataSent: Coordinates (latitude, longitude), search radius, stop ID, search query, origin and destination coordinates, departure/arrival time, trip ID, bounding box (for vehicle radar)
hafas.dataReceived: FPTF stops, departures/arrivals with delays/remarks, journeys with GeoJSON polylines and stopovers, live vehicle positions
